_comment: Crane game (UFO catcher, issue #132). One play costs the prize SKU's sell price; a customer plays up to max_plays (patience and money permitting) and stops at the first win; each play wins with 1 / win_one_in; play_seconds is the time per play at the machine. A win takes one prize (named from `prizes`) out of the machine. Fictional plush goods only; no real brand or character; in-game money only.
